tasks.notes: This class implements the core OAuth2 protocol flow according to Jobber API documentation. Uses shared HttpClient for consistent error handling and timeout behavior.

2. Constructor: OAuth2Manager(client_id: str, client_secret: str, redirect_uri: str, http_client: HttpClient)
3. Implement methods:
   - get_authorization_url(state: Optional[str] = None) -> str: builds authorization URL
   - exchange_code_for_tokens(authorization_code: str) -> dict: POST to /api/oauth/token
   - refresh_access_token(refresh_token: str) -> dict: POST to /api/oauth/token with refresh_token grant

tasks.name: Create token expiration utility functions
tasks.description: Create utility functions for JWT token expiration detection and validation using PyJWT library. These functions will be used by AuthProvider to determine when tokens need refreshing.
tasks.notes: These utilities provide clean interface for token expiration checking without requiring signature verification. Used by AuthProvider for automatic token refresh logic.
tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Create src/auth/token_utils.py with utility functions
2. Implement functions:
   - is_token_expired(token: str) -> bool: decode JWT and check exp claim
   - get_token_expiration(token: str) -> Optional[datetime]: extract exp claim as datetime
   - is_token_valid(token: str) -> bool: basic JWT structure validation
3. Use PyJWT library with options={'verify_signature': False, 'verify_exp': False}
4. Handle jwt.DecodeError for malformed tokens
5. Convert Unix timestamp from exp claim to datetime
6. Add 30-second buffer before expiration for refresh timing
7. Include comprehensive docstrings with examples
8. Follow existing naming conventions and error handling patterns

tasks.name: Enhance AuthProvider with OAuth2 support and backward compatibility
tasks.description: Extend the existing AuthProvider class to support OAuth2 token management while maintaining full backward compatibility with the current JOBBER_TOKEN environment variable approach. This provides automatic token refresh and seamless upgrade path.
tasks.notes: Critical to maintain backward compatibility. Users with JOBBER_TOKEN should experience zero changes. OAuth2 features are optional and additive only.

relatedFiles.description: Add OAuth2 support with backward compatibility

tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Modify src/auth/auth_provider.py constructor:
   AuthProvider(oauth_manager: Optional[OAuth2Manager] = None, repository: Optional[Repository] = None)
2. Enhance get_token() method to get_valid_token():
   - First check JOBBER_TOKEN environment variable (backward compatibility)
   - If not found and oauth_manager provided, get stored OAuth tokens
   - Check token expiration using token_utils
   - Auto-refresh if expired using oauth_manager.refresh_access_token()
   - Return valid access token
3. Keep existing get_token() method for backward compatibility
4. Update get_headers() method to use get_valid_token()
5. Add new methods:
   - is_oauth_configured() -> bool: check if OAuth2 dependencies available
   - clear_stored_tokens() -> None: clear OAuth tokens from storage
6. Error handling: ConfigurationError for auth failures, OAuth2Error for token issues
7. Maintain existing docstrings and add OAuth2 documentation
8. Follow dependency injection patterns from shrimp-rules.md
